title: Execution Logs Sway VLM Judges of Robot Progress
why: B-type evaluation/audit of VLM robot-progress judges: shows adjacent text execution logs can flip correct failure verdicts to progress; documents warning mitigations—directly relevant to trust of harness verification signals.
mechanism: Controlled progress-judge audit: on clips where the robot is losing progress, inject one fake progress log line (vs neutral) beside frames; measure verdict flips across Gemini/Qwen/GPT; test one-line distrust warning and fake task-complete claims.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: fake progress logs flip correct→progress 10–35 pp more than neutral across Gemini/Qwen/GPT; distrust warning removes most of the effect; fake task-complete flips ~half of Qwen correct verdicts vs ~tenth for unrelated lines; no detectable effect on Gemini for that claim (abs + HTML §3–4).
